verdict.rationale: The IPO documents a way to obtain copies of your patent, trade mark or design documents (uk-ipo-docs-19). It also documents ways to surrender or transfer registered marks (uk-ipo-docs-18, uk-ipo-docs-20), which gives a glancing route to retrieving records and 'leaving'. Nothing describes a self-service bulk export of an account's data or the formats the copies come in. Missing for 10: bulk or self-service export of all account and filing data, evidence of open machine-readable formats, and documentation of a data-portability or account-closure process.
